answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 979 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mirror. The jade index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the pearl queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 305 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
